name: Boardroom Governance
description: Board-level governance and voting for a tokenised entity. Reference implementation of the Registerwerk ONCHAINID permission-management framework: org membership, operator permission grants, org-admin role delegation with role restriction, and per-action ONCHAINID claim checks (KYC, Accreditation) — all enforced onchain via RegisterwerkGated and the PermissionOracle, without the dApp ever touching ONCHAINID or the permission registries directly.

requiredPermissions.rationale: Open a new board resolution for a vote
Cast a vote on an open board resolution
Close voting and record the resolution outcome — the reference role-restriction/delegation flow
